website.name: Invisible City Tours
website.executive_summary:
Invisible City Tours is a guide-led private day-trip brand (Lisbon–Cascais–Roca–Sintra). Phase-1 site is brochure + lead capture on Frank.

Matrix coverage must include all public menu routes: Home, Tours from Lisbon, Tours from Sintra, INTV/stories, Reviews, Vasco/Goodfoot, Contact, Privacy — not only Home/Contact/Privacy.

Voice: clear EN, sentence case, € pricing, WhatsApp/contact CTAs (no fake instant book in phase 1).

pages.name: Tours from Lisbon
pages.analysis_html: Core commercial page: Lisbon-start day trips. Live copy mixes strong product ideas with ALL CAPS, incomplete sentences, €/e inconsistency, and buried CTAs. Competitors win with clear from-prices, inclusions, and book paths. Should be package cards + one custom request path.
pages.guidelines_html: Sentence case EN; € before amount; duration + start + from-price above fold; CTAs Contact / WhatsApp; list inclusions/exclusions; max 3–4 public SKUs + custom.

sections.content_interpretation: Title-like meta only; weak SEO for private Sintra day trips.
sections.content_suggestion: Private Sintra & coast day trips from Lisbon — Classic, Grand Tour, and short options with a story-led guide.
